summary: Put each device's IP (if not reachable by name), ansible_network_os and ansible_user in inventory so you don't pass them on the command line.
questions: How do I set the network OS for each device in inventory?
Do I need ansible_host if my devices have DNS names?

answer_card.title: Per-device network variables
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
leafs:
  hosts:
    leaf01:
      ansible_host: 10.16.10.11
      ansible_network_os: vyos.vyos.vyos
      ansible_user: my_vyos_user
```
`ansible_host` is only needed if devices are reachable by IP only; skip it if hostnames resolve.
